caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a woman facing to the right, wearing a light brown, wide-brimmed bonnet decorated with ribbon bows on the side and under the chin; the ribbons are white with faint pink stripes. The bonnet has a curved brim with a patterned edge. The woman’s face is light in complexion with blue eyes, thin black eyebrows, a small nose, and pink lips. Her cheek is shaded with a faint blush, and a distinct solid black section represents her hair visible in front of her ear. She is dressed in a green garment with a black horizontal stripe near the top, and a white collar or scarf tied in a bow at the neck, similar in style and color to the bonnet ribbons. The background is plain, uncolored paper. The overall composition focuses on the upper portion of the figure, with no additional objects present.
title: Hat Mannequin and Bonnet
